question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{4,5,8,9,10,12,13\},$ and the set $S=\{4,5,8,9,10,12,13\}$ has $|S|=7$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{7}, & x=4,5,8,9,10,12,13 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $6$ items $(5,8,9,10,12,13)$ that satisfy $X\ge 5.$ Therefore,

$$
P(X\ge 5)=6\cdot \frac{1}{7}=\frac{6}{7}.
$$
